_about: What Operra does, one entry per feature page on operra.tech (text saved in brands/operra/site/, fetched 2026-10-23). The planner picks ONE feature per post (src/topics.js) and the writer is told to write about it. 'claims' are the only product facts for that feature; anything with a number is copied from the site. 'angles' are story seeds, not copy. Add a feature here only from the live site.
neverClaim: OTA / Booking.com / Agoda channel sync (on the site as ROADMAP, not live)
A hotel-room booking engine on the hotel's own website (not on the site)
Outcome percentages from the site's testimonials (e.g. room-service uplift, ticket-time cuts) until the owner approves them in facts.md

features.what: One screen with today's arrivals, departures, in-house guests, room status, outstanding balances and revenue collected, updated live.
claims: Live occupancy recalculated the moment a check-in is confirmed or a room is blocked
Shift hand-over is a ready dashboard: revenue, balances, arrivals, no WhatsApp recap
Mobile-money references attach to the folio line
Receipts carry a QR code and sequential numbering
angles: the morning shift hand-over that starts with a WhatsApp recap
the owner asks 'how much is outstanding right now?' and nobody knows
a guest who should have checked out yesterday is still in room
the receptionist flipping between a book, a calculator and a phone

features.what: A live room grid with a hard block on double-booking, group rooms in one screen, quotes that convert to reservations in one click, deposits by mobile money.
claims: Two receptionists cannot book the same room at the same time: hard conflict block
A quotation with line-item rates goes out as a branded PDF on WhatsApp or email
Quote converts to a reservation in one click, with the audit trail attached
Search any booking by guest, phone, room or booking code
Quotes in TSh, with USD on tap for international guests
angles: two receptionists sell the same room to two guests
the quote that sat in a WhatsApp chat and never became a booking
a group of rooms held on a paper list
the deposit paid by M-Pesa that nobody matched to the booking
'I thought you confirmed it'

features.what: Minibar, room service, laundry, late check-out, room moves and extensions post to the right folio from one page, with VAT and an audit stamp on every line.
claims: Any charge posts to the guest's folio in three taps
18% VAT applied after the discount, on every line
Several tenders on one bill: cash, card, mobile money or company account
A guest past departure with a balance turns red on every workstation
angles: the laundry or minibar charge that never reached the bill
a guest extends by two nights and the bill is rebuilt by hand
checkout morning: the folio does not match what the guest remembers
one bill paid half by card, half by M-Pesa

features.what: One profile per guest with every stay, charge and room attached; VIP and corporate flags raised automatically; NIDA and passport on the same form.
claims: Stay history follows the guest across every visit
VIP and corporate flags appear automatically when a guest qualifies
NIDA and passport captured on the same form
Every read of a profile is logged against the staff member who opened it
angles: the loyal guest treated like a stranger on the third visit
the receptionist who left took the guest relationships with her
asking a returning guest for their phone number again
the corporate guest whose company rate was forgotten

features.sw: Ramani ya vyumba moja kwa moja
features.what: Every room in every building on one screen: available, occupied, cleaning, maintenance or out of service, with transfers and blocks from the same page.
claims: Five room states counted live: available, occupied, cleaning, maintenance, out of service
Room moves and blocks are role-gated and audit-traced
Room types carry TSh pricing per night and maximum guests

the whiteboard behind reception that is always one hour old
moving a guest to another room without losing the bill

features.what: Rooms auto-assigned to housekeepers by floor and capacity, inspections with a per-item amenity check, and the board updates the front desk the moment a room is clean.
claims: Rooms are assigned to housekeepers automatically by floor and capacity
Per-item amenity check: water, slippers, minibar, every used item logged
Do-not-disturb respected: missed knocks go to a supervisor follow-up
Every status change is logged with who did it and when

towels and slippers that quietly walk out every week
a room missed in the daily refresh and a bad review

features.what: One POS for restaurant, bar, in-room dining, takeaway and events; settles to cash, card, mobile money or straight to the guest's room, with waiter attribution and split bills.
claims: Settle to cash, card, mobile money, the room folio or the event ledger
Rush Mode: two taps to seated, three to settled
Every order line is attributed to a waiter; tips and covers tracked per waiter
Split a bill by item or by share, transfer between tables
18% VAT applied after the discount, on every receipt
angles: the bar tab that never reached the room bill
a full dining room and a POS that needs ten taps
nobody knows which waiter served table four
the walk-in who pays half by card and half by M-Pesa
a restaurant that runs separately from the hotel's books

features.what: Orders from the POS land on the right kitchen station with modifiers, allergens and course pacing; tickets age and turn amber; sold dishes deduct stock.
claims: Tickets go to the right station with modifiers and allergens
Tickets change colour as they age past target
Starters do not fire with mains: course pacing
Recipe deduction trims stock when a dish is sold
angles: the paper chit that fell behind the grill
a waiter shouting orders through the hatch
the starter and the main arriving together
the allergy note that never reached the chef

features.en: In-room QR menu and online ordering
features.what: A permanent QR sticker in each room opens the menu; the guest confirms with a stay PIN, orders, the front desk approves, the kitchen gets it and the bill goes to the room.
claims: One permanent QR sticker per room, or the link sent on WhatsApp at check-in
Guests confirm with a stay PIN, so outsiders cannot order against a room
Every order is approved at the front desk before it reaches the kitchen
Approved orders post to the room folio automatically
Guests can reserve a restaurant table from the same screen
Menu prices shown in TZS or USD

the room-service chit that was never charged

features.what: A live floor plan for every outlet, two-tap seating, tab transfers and splits, and a public booking link guests can use from Instagram, WhatsApp or the website.
claims: One public reservation link to share on Instagram, WhatsApp or the website

claims: Venue calendar by day, month or list

One branded dossier the client signs and the auditor accepts
Deposits and balances settled by M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money or card
Event payments restricted by role

claims: Per-company credit limits; over-limit charges blocked until finance approves
Ageing buckets: 0-30, 31-60, 61-90 and 90+ days

month-end statements built from Excel rows

features.what: Every folio, POS post and event payment rolls into one ledger and the P&L instantly; folios are numbered without gaps; VAT is applied after discounts.

Every report exports as a branded PDF
Occupancy, ADR, RevPAR and revenue per room type

claims: Every action is bound to a user, role and time: no anonymous edits
